implemented: Threshold fitting is limited to TRAIN rows within the frozen date window; future-dated and non-TRAIN rows are rejected.
Controls come from a separate source manifest, cannot reuse candidate event IDs, must be same-session/time-bucket/stratum and different-symbol, and can be used once.
Thresholds with incomplete same-time control coverage are excluded; net excess is computed after supplied training costs.
The deterministic frozen policy carries data/source hashes and training denominators and exposes score-only selection without any forward schedule input.
